Privacy Policy

Updated 16 October 2026

Your account

Firebase Authentication manages your Google or email/password sign-in identity and email verification. AIMER Society stores your Firebase user ID, email, name, optional mobile number, Google profile photo URL when available, signup time, and latest sign-in time in Neon. Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication and are not sent to our application API or stored in Neon. Your mobile number is optional contact information, not SMS-verified and not used for phone login or marketing in this implementation.

Your learning space

While browsing as a guest, favorites, pins, and recent activity are stored in this browser. When signed in, these preferences are also stored with your account so this dashboard can restore them across devices. Interests, your display name, and your mobile number can be changed on your profile page. Learning progress inside separate subject websites is not tracked by this dashboard.

Sessions and service providers

A secure, HttpOnly cookie keeps your session for up to five days and is scoped to aimersociety.com. Integrated AIMER subdomains can use it to recognize your session. Google/Firebase provides sign-in and authentication emails, Neon stores account data, and Vercel hosts this website. The dashboard also loads Google Analytics; analytics may collect usage and device information under Google's policies.

Your choices

You can browse without an account, skip interest selection, add or remove your mobile number, edit your profile, clear recent activity, or sign out. Signing out removes this browser’s shared login session; it does not delete your account or previously saved data. Browser-local saves remain on that device. For account-data questions or deletion requests, use the contact details published on the AIMER Society website.
